failure_summary_missing_on_controlled_fa.defect: The exception path previously marked the ledger FAILED and re-raised without publishing result_path.
failure_summary_missing_on_controlled_fa.consequence: A started failed attempt could lack its immutable terminal summary.
failure_summary_missing_on_controlled_fa.repair: All post-RUNNING failures now publish a bounded summary and ledger FAILED before propagation.

bad_terminal_not_summarized.defect: Non-terminal runtime outcomes were raised before the old success summary was written.
bad_terminal_not_summarized.consequence: MODEL_STEP_LIMIT, PROTOCOL_STALLED, and provider terminal outcomes could lose final evidence.
bad_terminal_not_summarized.repair: Terminal outcomes are classified, summarized, atomically written, and then propagated.

literal_smoke_safety_summary.defect: The old result used a literal safety object instead of the runtime safety counters.
literal_smoke_safety_summary.consequence: A nonzero measured runtime safety counter could be hidden.
literal_smoke_safety_summary.repair: runtime_measured_safety is mapped from result.safety and nonzero values fail closed.

rerun_refusal.defect: Existing result/run directory checks are retained.
rerun_refusal.consequence: Failed evidence cannot be overwritten or rerun.

classification_matrix.LIVE_SMOKE_PASS: terminal SUBMIT or STOP, evidence, accounting, persistence, replay, trace, and safety checks pass
classification_matrix.LIVE_SMOKE_HARNESS_FAILURE: persistence, replay, accounting, invalid terminal, or measured safety failure
classification_matrix.LIVE_SMOKE_PROVIDER_FAILURE: provider construction/transport or runtime PROVIDER_ERROR after preflight
classification_matrix.preflight_failure: outside this result artifact lifecycle; provider construction remains unreachable

offline_tests.pass_path: result artifact exists; classification LIVE_SMOKE_PASS; ledger COMPLETE
offline_tests.model_step_limit_path: result artifact and failure artifact exist; interaction-not-ready; ledger FAILED; rerun refused
offline_tests.protocol_stalled_path: result artifact and failure artifact exist; interaction-not-ready; ledger FAILED
offline_tests.provider_failure_path: typed provider error summarized as LIVE_SMOKE_PROVIDER_FAILURE; ledger FAILED
offline_tests.replay_mismatch_path: summary persisted as LIVE_SMOKE_HARNESS_FAILURE; ledger FAILED
offline_tests.accounting_mismatch_path: summary persisted before propagated failure; ledger FAILED
offline_tests.structural_isolation_path: execution module has no judge or ground-truth-loader dependency
